The image features a prominent central fig cut in half, displaying a deep red to amber interior filled with numerous tiny seeds and fleshy pulp. Surrounding it are other slices showing the transition from the pale greenish-yellow skin to the vibrant inner flesh. The texture appears moist and jam-like.
